name: gitlab
description: Official GitLab MCP server — drive gitlab.com or a self-hosted GitLab instance from the agent: list and search projects, read and push files, manage branches, open merge requests, file and triage issues, and fork repositories. Authenticated with a personal access token; no extra installs required.

interface.shortDescription: Drive any GitLab instance (cloud or self-hosted) through the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can work directly with your GitLab projects — browsing code, creating merge requests, managing issues, and running CI pipelines. Works with gitlab.com or your own self-hosted GitLab instance. No more switching between your chat and the GitLab interface: just ask your agent to create a merge request, triage an issue, push a change, or check the pipeline status.
defaultPrompt: Show me the latest merge requests and their review status.
Create a new issue in my project to track this bug.
Check the CI pipeline status for my latest commit.
